_comment: Sahama's own switches. Read ONLY through lib/sahama/config.ts (fail-closed: a missing or malformed value counts as off / the shipped default). checkinReplies: whether Sahama writes a personal AI reply to a check-in — off means the note is still saved, just not answered (and the AI notice disappears with it, lib/ai/disclosure.mjs). freeRepliesPerWeek: how many personal replies a member WITHOUT the sahama plan gets per Berlin week (operator, 2026-11-19: 1 — was 3 in total before; the free tier has to stay alive over months). adviceUrl: the operator's page for written advice; Sahama points there when somebody wants to go deeper — null until the page exists, then the replies name 'persönliche schriftliche Beratung' without a link. moreInfoUrl: the operator's own Ayurveda site; every article ends with a pointer to it for those who want to go deeper (operator, 2026-11-19).
